subject: Data description entry
notes: kb/Work PB522 LANDED — the implication and its ANTECEDENT are both correct now. THE IMPLICATION itself was always right: UsageInheritancePass walks every group child of a group whose GroupUsage is set and applies `if (c.GroupUsage is GroupUsage.None) c.GroupUsage = item.GroupUsage;` BEFORE the recursive descent, so it is transitive; conformance:cases/13.16-Data-description/pb79_group_usage_bit pins the direct arm (SUB-LEN=4, derived from 13.18.29.4 GR1b + 15.50.4 r1). WHAT WAS PARTIAL, AND IS NOW CLOSED: the antecedent 'subordinate to a bit group' was destroyed whenever the bit group arrived through a description COPY — DataItem.GroupUsage was absent from BOTH copy helpers (CopyEntryDescription, the shared 13.18.57.4 GR1 / 13.18.49.4 GR1 body, and CloneItem, the per-node subordinate clone), so `01 BDEF IS TYPEDEF GROUP-USAGE BIT. 02 BT1. 03 BB PIC 1(3) USAGE BIT.` + `01 VIA-BIT TYPE BDEF.` measured LEN-VIABIT=1 / LEN-BT1=1 where the spec requires 3 and 3, and the SAME AS twin measured LEN-BDST=1 / LEN-BG-DST=1 against a correct LEN-BSRC=5. GROUP-USAGE (13.18.29) is in NEITHER GR-1 exclusion list — 13.18.57.4 GR1 excludes only the level-number, name, alignment, GLOBAL, SELECT WHEN and TYPEDEF; 13.18.49.4 GR1 only the level-number, name, CONSTANT RECORD, EXTERNAL, GLOBAL, REDEFINES and SELECT WHEN — and 13.18.49.4 GR4 propagating a GROUP-USAGE from data-name-1's SUPERORDINATE confirms the clause is meant to travel. THE FIX is structural, at the ONE place the rule belongs: CopyEntryDescription is now the only copy and CloneItem funnels through it (its initializer carries identity, the renumbered level and the MemberOnly fields alone), and every stored DataItem property carries a [DescriptionCopy] classification with its citing reason, enforced behaviourally by unit:DescriptionCopyCompletenessDriftTests. MEASURED at 2002/2014/2023 on this worktree's own build: the golden's B line reads `B=3 3 CTL=3 3` — the copy and its byte-identical inline control agreeing, where they read 1 1 against 3 3 before. EDITIONS unchanged: 2002/2014/2023, COBOL0900 at --std 85, pinned by conformance:cases/13.16-Data-description/pb522-group-usage-copy-below-2002.
